{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Destroyer}}
[[File:Imperial-I-SD-ANH.jpg|250px|thumb|The ''Imperial''-class was a mid-sized, mass-produced warship that served as the workhorse of the Galactic Empire and influenced several destroyer and Star Destroyer designs.]]

'''Destroyer''' was a formal designation usually reserved for the medium-sized warships in a fleet,<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> below that of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]].<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Often, these vessels were similar to small [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and could operate in flotillas or independently. Many classes were highly versatile and were capable of functioning as peacekeeping battleships in localized conflicts,<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> as well as being escorts for larger vessels.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

In some navies and eras, the destroyer was one of the largest [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in the fleet. Such was the case with the [[Sith Destroyer]]s which served the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the final stages of the [[New Sith Wars]],<ref name="DB:POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> and the [[Fel Empire]] with its [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="SWL0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>

Besides star-bound destroyers, there were also maritime destroyers, which also included a specialized version called missile destroyers for taking down air-bound vehicles during [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground warfare]].<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

The term "[[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]," although containing "destroyer," did not necessarily indicate a destroyer-class ship and was used for a wide variety of warships.<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> Some Imperial documents also listed the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer's ship type as "destroyer."<ref name="ACME">[["Imperial Star Destroyer" SpecPlate]]</ref>

==Known destroyer designs==
[[File:Aggressor_destroyer.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Aggressor''-class was the second-largest warship in the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] navy.]]

===[[Adz-class patrol destroyer|''Adz''-class patrol destroyer]]===
The 150-meter-long ''Adz''-class destroyer was a small warship used for picket and patrol duties by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

===[[Aggressor-class destroyer|''Aggressor''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Aggressor''-class was the second-largest warship in the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] forces and based on an Imperial design. It was armed with two large cannons to take out other warships.

===[[Bakura-class destroyer|''Bakura''-class destroyer]]===
The ''Bakura''-class was built around the ''Imperial II''-class reactor. Only three were known to have been built and participated in the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]] conflict, on the side of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

===[[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The 600-meters-long ''Gladiator''-class was a small Star Destroyer design used to intimidate outlying systems in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

===[[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The 1,600-meter ''Imperial''-class was the signature vessel of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and was used to intimidate weaker systems into submission with its very presence. It was large enough to command fleets, and fast enough to hunt down [[blockade runner]]s. Over 25,000 ships were built.

===[[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class Sith Destroyer]]===
The 600-meter ''Interdictor''-class used by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] under [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was alternatively referred to as a Sith Destroyer.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===[[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The 1,040-meter ''Nebula''-class was an expensive and powerful, compact New Republic design, made to overpower any other Star Destroyer class and even withstand some kinds of Super Star Destroyer. This made the vessels very expensive and consequently few were built, although they aquitted themselves well in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

===[[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Pellaeon''-class was an advanced Star Destroyer that served as one of the most powerful classes in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around 100 years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It used design elements found in both the ''Imperial II''-class and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]].

===[[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]===
The ''Providence''-class was both a destroyer and a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], with a large central hangar located towards the stern of the vessel. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] modified several vessels to carry even more vehicles and troops, and used one of them as his personal command ship, the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].

===[[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]]===
The ''Recusant''-class was a light destroyer design that was armed with heavy artillery for a ship of its size.
They were mostly automated and hunted larger vessels in packs, but were often single-minded in their tasks, which opened them up for assault by enemy vessels.

===[[Rejuvenator-class Star Destroyer|''Rejuvenator''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Rejuvenator''-class fought in the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]].

===[[Republic-class Star Destroyer|''Republic''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Republic''-class was a contemporary of the ''Nebula''-class and dispersed through several New Republic task forces.

[[File:Destroyer_Geonosis.jpg|250px|thumb|The Sabaoth destroyer was the main fighting ship of the [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]].]]

===[[Sabaoth destroyer]]===
The Sabaoth was the largest warship design of the [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]], a mercenary fleet of warships. It participated in the run-up to the Clone Wars.

===[[Sith Destroyer]]===
The Sith Destroyer was a ship-design used by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the final conflicts of the [[New Sith Wars]]. One such vessel, the [[Nightfall (Sith Destroyer)|''Nightfall'']], served as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan's]] flagship.
The [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]] was also referred to as a Sith Destroyer while in service of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]], almost 1,500 years earlier.

===[[Storm Fleet destroyer]]===
The Storm Fleet destroyer was a warship built by KDY for the Separatist cause early in the Clone Wars. They were disguised as freighters to easily travel to their targets, unaligned worlds with resources coveted by the CIS movement. Destroyed by Republic forces, Kuat managed to evade prosecution for the [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] act of building them.

===[[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Tector''-class was a Star Destroyer design that had no hangars. As such it was more protected than most other classes. Ships of this kind participated in the Clone Wars and [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[File:Terminus-class.jpg|160px|thumb|''Terminus''-class destroyers became a common sight within Imperial fleets during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]].]]

===[[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class Destroyer]]===
The ''Terminus''-class destroyer was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and was seen in use by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

===[[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Venator''-class gained fame as command ships of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] during the Clone Wars. They were primarily fighting ships, but also doubled as carriers, and had a long-running dorsal carrier deck, complete with armored doors. Future designs did away with this cumbersome solution.

===[[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]===
The ''Victory''-class was inspired by the ''Acclamator''-class [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] but had less carrier facilities than contemporary designs, like the ''Venator''-class. Despite this, the class saw service in multiple governments.
